diagnostic_definitions.weighting: normal force normalized over contacts of feet with total normal force > 1e-6 N
diagnostic_definitions.boundary: preintegration step_observation; no mj_forward during observation
diagnostic_definitions.integration: Each t_n term times dt; separate v_next-v_n term matches semiimplicit translation
diagnostic_definitions.window: Exact current gait/energy endpoint selection; integrate all steps in [i0*record_every,i1*record_every)
diagnostic_definitions.inference_limit: Identity reconstruction is not an independent validation or replacement of existing stride gate; actual schedule/slip/compliance are observed inputs

diagnostic.interpretation: Algebraic/kinematic decomposition conditional on actual contact schedule; reconstruction is not independent physical validation.
